blocks.title: PABX & Business Telephony Solutions
blocks.subtitle: Clear Calls. Connected Teams. Reliable Communication.
paragraphs: Modern business runs on communication. True Line designs and installs PABX and IP telephony systems that keep your teams connected, your customers reached, and your operations running smoothly — from a few users to enterprise scale.

blocks.title: Business Phone Systems, Done Right
paragraphs: Whether you need a simple multi-line phone system or a feature-rich IP PABX with call recording, IVR, and remote extensions, the right telephony solution can transform how your team communicates — internally and with customers.

True Line delivers PABX and IP telephony solutions tailored to your business size, branch structure, and call patterns. From traditional PABX to modern IP-based systems and cloud-ready hybrid setups, we design, install, and maintain telephony solutions that deliver crystal-clear calls and rock-solid reliability.
